original:
- name: Claim

    table: Claim

    primary_key: [Claim_Identifier]

    description: A record representing an insurance claim made by a policyholder.

- name: Claim_Amount

    table: Claim_Amount

    primary_key: [Claim_Amount_Identifier]

    description: Represents the monetary amounts associated with a specific claim, such as loss or expense values.

- name: Loss_Payment

    table: Loss_Payment

    primary_key: [Claim_Amount_Identifier]

    description: A record indicating that a payment was made for a loss related to a claim amount.

- name: Loss_Reserve

    table: Loss_Reserve

    primary_key: [Claim_Amount_Identifier]

    description: Represents the reserve amount set aside for a loss associated with a claim amount.

- name: Expense_Payment

    table: Expense_Payment

    primary_key: [Claim_Amount_Identifier]

    description: A record indicating that an expense payment was made related to a claim amount.

- name: Expense_Reserve

    table: Expense_Reserve

    primary_key: [Claim_Amount_Identifier]

    description: Represents the reserve amount set aside for expenses associated with a claim amount.

- name: Claim_Coverage

    table: Claim_Coverage

    primary_key: [Claim_Identifier, Effective_Date, Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier]

    description: Indicates which policy coverage applies to a specific claim and when it becomes effective.

- name: Policy_Coverage_Detail

    table: Policy_Coverage_Detail

    primary_key: [Effective_Date, Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier]

    description: Details about the coverage provided under an insurance policy for a specific period of time.

- name: Policy

    table: Policy

    primary_key: [Policy_Identifier]

    description: Represents an individual insurance policy with its effective and expiration dates, along with other details like the policy number and geographic location.

- name: Policy_Amount

    table: Policy_Amount

    primary_key: [Policy_Amount_Identifier]

    description: A record representing a specific monetary amount associated with a policy, such as premiums or reserves, for a particular coverage detail and time period.

- name: Agreement_Party_Role

    table: Agreement_Party_Role

    primary_key: [Agreement_Identifier, Party_Identifier, Party_Role_Code, Effective_Date]

    description: Describes the role of a party in an agreement, including when their role becomes effective and expires.

- name: Premium

    table: Premium

    primary_key: [Policy_Amount_Identifier]

    description: A record indicating that a premium payment was made for a specific policy amount.
